page.overview:
What is Shade Port?

Shade Port is a port on an island located somewhere in the Grand Line. It is where Marshall D. Teach, later the Emperor Blackbeard, was born.

Forty years ago, Marshall D. Teach was born in the Shade Port to Rocks D. Xebec and Eris. Worried due to his status as a member of the Davy Family, Xebec sent his wife and child to God Valley, where he believed they would be safe from the World Government.
